import datetime
now=datetime.datetime.now()
this_year=now.year
last_year=now.year-1
print('now',now,'years',this_year,last_year)

# login
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pass = next(c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify')
username='timothy.whit@gmail.com'
login_resp=apis.spotify.login(username=username, password=spotify_pass)
access_token=login_resp['access_token']

playlist_id=654
pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=access_token)
existing_ids=set(s['id'] for s in pl.get('songs',[]))
print('existing_playlist_song_ids_count',len(existing_ids),'ids',sorted(list(existing_ids)))

# fetch all recommendations
recs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    recs.extend(page)
    print('recs_page',page_index,'added',len(page),'total',len(recs))
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>100:
        break
print('total_recommendations',len(recs))

# filter R&B by show_song.genre and release_date year
cand=[]
for rec in recs:
    sid=rec['song_id']
    song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_date=song.get('release_date')
    genre=song.get('genre')
    # parse year
    year=None
    if isinstance(release_date,str) and len(release_date)>=4:
        try:
            year=int(release_date[:4])
        except:
            year=None
    gnorm = genre.lower().strip() if isinstance(genre,str) else ''
    is_rnb = ('r&b' in gnorm) or (gnorm in {'r&b','rhythm & blues','rhythm &blues','rhythm and blues','rhythmandblues'})
    if year in (this_year,last_year) and is_rnb:
        artists = [a['name'] for a in (song.get('artists') or [])]
        cand.append({'song_id':sid,'title':song.get('title'),'artists':artists,'genre':genre,'release_date':release_date,'year':year})

# deduplicate by song_id
seen=set(); unique=[]
for x in cand:
    if x['song_id'] not in seen:
        seen.add(x['song_id']); unique.append(x)

candidate_ids=sorted([x['song_id'] for x in unique])
print('candidate_count',len(unique))
print('candidate_ids',candidate_ids)

# print details
for x in sorted(unique,key=lambda d:d['song_id']):
    print('candidate',x['song_id'],x['title'],'artists',x['artists'],'genre',x['genre'],'release',x['release_date'])

# delta set
already=list(existing_ids.intersection(set(candidate_ids)))
need=[sid for sid in candidate_ids if sid not in existing_ids]
print('Already in target state:',sorted(already),'(',len(already),')')
print('Need action:',need,'(',len(need),')')

# add songs
results=[]
for sid in need:
    r=apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=access_token)
    results.append((sid,r))
print('added_count',len(results))
print('add_results_sample',results[:5])

# verify final state
pl2=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=access_token)
final_ids=set(s['id'] for s in pl2.get('songs',[]))
print('final_playlist_song_ids_count',len(final_ids))
print('final_contains_candidates',len(final_ids.intersection(set(candidate_ids))))
print('missing_candidates',sorted(set(candidate_ids)-final_ids))
print('extra_songs_not_in_candidates',sorted(final_ids-set(candidate_ids))[:20])
